subject: CFStringRef<->NSString*

observation.summary: Runtime probe creates an NSString via @"hello" and casts it as a CFTypeRef via __bridge; CFGetTypeID() returns 7, identical to CFStringGetTypeID() (also 7). Reverse direction: CFStringCreateWithCString returns a CFStringRef whose __bridge NSString* identity equals the CFStringRef pointer, demonstrating identity-preservation. CFBridgingRetain produces a CFStringRef with CFStringGetTypeID(). All four behaviours confirm CFStringRef and NSString* share the same underlying CFTypeID.

claim: On this host (macOS 27 arm64e) CFStringRef is identity-preserved with NSString* under __bridge cast, has CFTypeID 7 matching CFStringGetTypeID(), and round-trips through CFBridgingRetain; this is the canonical toll-free bridge between CFString and NSString.
